summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a strategic commercial relationship and investment between the registrant's subsidiary, Aether Compute LLC, and Virtual Grid Inc., covering an exclusive white-label supply and distribution agreement for modular compute-and-energy pods in Southeast Asia. The registrant itself is not a party to the supply or FOMA agreements and has no liability under them. The disclosure concerns a corporate partner/distribution deal with a related party (board member Timothy Murphy is CEO of Virtual Grid). There are no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation deal terms; it is a routine current report on a material definitive agreement and not a special situation.
